briefing.headline: xAI and DeepSeek launch 1T-parameter open models, intensifying frontier race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models amid record funding. Geopolitical tensions are driving compute nationalism while safety concerns mount. Multi-agent systems are seeing rapid deployment in enterprise.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-4 with enhanced reasoning. DeepSeek open-sourced its 1T model. OpenAI's o4 preview shows gains in long-context tasks. Anthropic and Google continue internal scaling of next-gen systems.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with patent-pending multi-agent security for automotive and IoT.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping. Microsoft and Google expanded data center builds in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports 3nm yield improvements for AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed labs by end of 2027?
